title: cross-model primer weaver and kernel saturation emulator
author: Aisha Carter
description: Introduce a new benchmark harness that composes cross-model primer weaving with a stochastic kernel-saturation emulator to better surface multi-model contention and warmup hysteresis. Motivation: existing runners exercise single-model hotpaths and do not simulate realistic cross-model primer interleaving seen in production where multiple model families share GPU pools. This PR implements a PrimerWeaver orchestrator that synthesizes interleaved primer sequences across 2-6 model variants with configurable affinity and overlap, a SaturationEmulator that models kernel queueing and thermal backpressure via a saturation_index metric, and exporters that produce per-epoch quantiles, occupancy histograms, and a compact flame snapshot compatible with the perf-lab visualization pipeline. The design focuses on deterministic repeatability (seeded sampler), lightweight state checkpoints for kvcache priming, and an opt-in fidelity mode that trades sampling fidelity for throughput in CI smoke runs. Includes a small set of canonical workload manifests and a migration note for existing benchmark scripts.

notes_for_eng: When running locally set BENCH_SEED for deterministic runs. Use fidelity=low for CI smoke. SaturationEmulator supports two modes: synthetic-latency and thermal-proxy; thermal-proxy requires env var EMULATE_THERMAL=true. See docs/bench/primer_weaver.md for tuning knobs and example manifests.
